responsibility: This file defines the NDS32 machine constraints used by reload, recog, and instruction selection in the port’s RTL patterns. It classifies target register subsets, immediate encodings, vector constants, and memory addressing forms for 16-bit and 32-bit instructions—including specialized constraints for performance-extension bit operations, movpi45, addri36.sp, floating constants, and multiple-load/store bases—so neighboring .md files can express exactly which operands are legal for each NDS32 instruction form.
